Container.Name: dango
Container.Overview:
MitarashiDango is a lightweight, local-first anime media client and tracker designed for performance, privacy, and low resource usage. Featuring modular streaming extensions, full Shoko Server integration for local media playback, hardware-accelerated on-the-fly remuxing, dual-audio and subtitle track selection, two-way watch status scrobbling, and fast offline AniDB-AniList cross-referencing.
[b]Default WebUI:[/b] http://[IP]:3000 [b]Persistent Data:[/b] All databases, installed extensions, settings, and sync manifests are stored under /config/dango/ (mapped to /mnt/user/appdata/dango by default). [b]Hardware Acceleration:[/b] Map /dev/dri to enable Intel QuickSync (VAAPI) or AMD GPU hardware transcoding.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Web interface port accessible from your browser.

Config.Name: Appdata Storage
Config.Description: Location on your Unraid server where Dango stores the SQLite database (anime.db), sync tokens, and config files.

Config.Name: Transcode Scratch Path
Config.Description: Scratch directory for remuxing and video transcoding. Using /tmp/dango-transcode (RAM) or cache drive provides high performance.

Config.Name: Shoko Server URL
Config.Description: URL/IP of your Shoko Server instance (e.g., http://192.168.1.100 or http://[HOST_IP]).

Config.Name: Shoko API Key
Config.Description: Optional API Key for Shoko Server authentication (can also be configured in Dango Settings UI).

Config.Name: Hardware Acceleration
Config.Description: Hardware acceleration mode: auto, vaapi (Intel/AMD), nvenc (NVIDIA), or software.

Config.Name: GPU /dev/dri Device
Config.Description: Pass through Intel QuickSync / AMD VAAPI GPU device for hardware accelerated video playback.

Config.Name: FlareSolverr Enabled
Config.Description: Enable FlareSolverr integration to automatically solve and bypass Cloudflare challenges (true/false).

Config.Name: FlareSolverr URL
Config.Description: URL/IP of your FlareSolverr container or host (e.g., http://192.168.1.100 or http://flaresolverr if sharing a Docker network).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file permissions (Unraid default: 99 / nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file permissions (Unraid default: 100 / users).
